## Capabilities
- 3 re-check strategies (http-hash, oembed, hf-dataset)
- Machine-readable findings (cwi.watch-finding/1.0)
- ?watch=<envelope-url> deep links
- Dogfood: CWI's own 8 trust-log envelopes
- 40/40 tests

## How an agent should use this
- Fetch https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-verdict-watch/ to use or evaluate the product.
- Fetch the agent card for the canonical capability schema before relying on any claim.
- Never upgrade the data_truth label: SAMPLE means the page shows simulated or seed data; LIVE means its facts are live-verified.
- Contact: hp@cumulativeweb.com
